name: GIMP
title: GIMP: free Photoshop alternative
hook: Photoshop charges you twenty bucks a month to edit your photos. This app does it for free.

features.say: Work in layers, fix colors with curves, and watch the changes live.
Filters stay editable, so you can tweak them later. It opens Photoshop PSD files too.

caption:
Photoshop costs $19.99/month to edit your photos. GIMP does it for free 📸

✅ Edit photos in layers, with curves and color filters
✅ Filters stay editable, so you can tweak them later
✅ Opens and saves Photoshop PSD files
✅ No subscription, no watermarks, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The interface is different from Photoshop, so expect a learning curve. Photoshop price is the Photography plan (includes Lightroom), billed monthly on an annual plan
